title: Adaptive Optimization
brief: ML auto-tuning. Model selector (logistic regression), effort predictor, maxTurns optimizer, skill routing, token budget predictor, hook priority ranking, cron freq optimizer, dedup ML tuner, warm-start predictor, cost optimizer, A/B test framework, convergence tests.

phases.title: Core Predictors
phases.description: Model selector, effort predictor, maxTurns optimizer, and skill routing

units.title: Model Selector (Logistic Regression)
units.rationale: Select optimal model tier (opus/sonnet/haiku) per task using logistic regression on task features
exit_conditions: Logistic regression model trained on task features → model tier
Selection accuracy > 80% on held-out data
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define task feature vector (complexity, token estimate, domain, tool requirements)
Implement online logistic regression with SGD updates from observed outcomes
Add tests for model selection accuracy and online learning convergence

units.description: Model Selector (Logistic Regression) — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Effort Predictor
units.rationale: Predict optimal reasoning_effort (0-100) per task to avoid over/under-thinking
exit_conditions: Effort prediction within +/-10 of optimal for 75% of tasks
Feedback loop from task outcome to update predictor
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Build effort predictor using linear regression on task features and historical outcomes
Implement feedback loop: compare predicted vs actual needed effort from outcome quality
Add tests for prediction accuracy and feedback convergence

deliverables.description: Task effort level predictor with feedback learning

units.description: Effort Predictor — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MaxTurns Optimizer
units.rationale: Dynamically set agent maxTurns based on task complexity to prevent premature stops or wasted turns
exit_conditions: MaxTurns prediction correlates with actual turns needed (r > 0.7)
Saves > 10% wasted turns on average
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Analyze historical agent runs to build turns-needed distribution by task type
Implement Poisson regression predictor for optimal maxTurns
Add tests for prediction accuracy and waste reduction

deliverables.description: Dynamic maxTurns predictor for agent tasks

units.description: MaxTurns Optimizer — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Skill Router
units.rationale: Route user queries to optimal skill based on learned success patterns
exit_conditions: Skill suggestion accuracy > 70%
Routing table updates from outcome feedback
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Build keyword/pattern to skill mapping from historical invocation data
Implement cosine similarity matching with TF-IDF features
Add tests for routing accuracy and cold-start handling

deliverables.description: ML-based skill routing from query patterns

units.description: Skill Router — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

phases.title: Resource Optimizers
phases.description: Token budget predictor, hook priority ranking, cron frequency optimizer, and dedup ML tuner

units.title: Token Budget Predictor
units.rationale: Predict token budget needed per task to set guardrails and avoid context window overflow
exit_conditions: Token budget prediction within 20% of actual for 80% of tasks
Budget warning emitted when predicted usage approaches limit
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Build token budget predictor using log-linear regression on task features
Implement early warning when predicted cumulative tokens approach context limit
Add tests for prediction accuracy and warning timeliness

deliverables.description: Token budget prediction and early warning

units.description: Token Budget Predictor — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Hook Priority Ranker
units.rationale: Dynamically rank hook execution priority based on observed impact and latency cost
exit_conditions: Hooks ranked by impact/cost ratio
Low-impact high-cost hooks deprioritized or skipped
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Compute hook impact score (blocks prevented, warnings acted on) and cost (latency)
Implement priority ranking with impact/cost ratio sorting
Add tests for ranking stability and impact score accuracy

deliverables.description: Dynamic hook priority ranking by impact/cost

units.description: Hook Priority Ranker — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Cron Frequency Optimizer
units.rationale: Auto-tune cron job frequencies based on observed data change rates and utility
exit_conditions: Cron frequencies adjusted based on data staleness patterns
Resource savings from reduced unnecessary runs
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Track data change rates between cron runs to identify over/under-polling
Implement exponential backoff/advance based on change rate
Add tests for frequency adaptation and stability

units.description: Cron Frequency Optimizer — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Dedup ML Tuner
units.rationale: Auto-tune dedup window sizes and similarity thresholds using ML on FP/FN rates
entry_conditions: CCM-MS14 dedup FP tracking data available
exit_conditions: Dedup parameters auto-tuned per tool type
FP rate < 1% and FN rate < 5%
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Collect FP/FN outcomes per dedup window size and threshold combination
Implement grid search with Bayesian optimization for optimal parameters
Add tests for parameter convergence and rate targets

units.description: Dedup ML Tuner — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Warm-Start Predictor
units.rationale: Predict which context to preload at session start based on user patterns
entry_conditions: Token budget predictor and session metrics available
exit_conditions: Context preload reduces first-query latency by > 15%
Preload set size bounded by token budget
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Analyze session-start patterns to identify commonly needed context per user/project
Build predictor using frequency-recency scoring with token budget constraint
Add tests for preload relevance and budget compliance

units.description: Warm-Start Predictor — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Cost Optimizer
units.rationale: Minimize total API cost while maintaining quality by optimizing model/effort/token allocation
entry_conditions: Model selector, effort predictor, and token budget predictor operational
exit_conditions: Cost reduction > 15% vs baseline with same quality
Pareto frontier of cost vs quality computed
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Build cost model (price per input/output token by model tier)
Implement multi-objective optimizer balancing cost, quality, and latency
Add tests for Pareto optimality and cost reduction validation

units.description: Cost Optimizer — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

exit_conditions: A/B test framework with random assignment and significance testing
Chi-squared and Mann-Whitney tests for outcome comparison
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Build A/B test framework with experiment definition, random assignment, and outcome tracking
Implement statistical significance tests (chi-squared for categorical, Mann-Whitney for continuous)
Add tests for randomization balance and statistical test correctness

deliverables.description: A/B testing framework with significance testing

units.rationale: Verify all adaptive optimizers converge and don't oscillate or degrade system behavior
exit_conditions: Convergence tests pass for all optimizers (monotonic improvement over 100 iterations)
Integration test verifies no oscillation when all optimizers run simultaneously
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Write convergence tests for each optimizer with synthetic data
Write integration test running all optimizers together to detect interference
Add stability tests verifying bounded parameter drift over 1000 iterations

deliverables.description: Convergence and integration tests for all adaptive optimizers
